text: はじめに　ベトベター　だして…　いいや　ほかので　いっきに…　…　うーん　ブツ　ブツ…

structure.jp: はじめに　ベトベター　だして…
ほかので　いっきに…
structure.en: all at once with another one...

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て ending on a verb says 'do this, and then...', leaving the next step to follow. Here the speaker trails off before saying it. だして… = 'send out, and then...'

patterns.name: 〜の (one)
patterns.explanation: の here stands in for a thing already talked about, like English 'one', so the Pokémon does not have to be named again. ほかの = 'another one'

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.span: ほかので　いっきに
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says that thing is what you use to do it. The verb is left unsaid as the speaker trails off. ほかので　いっきに = 'all at once with another one'
